core_meaning.primary_meaning: Mizan is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Balance, scale, justice”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Mizan corresponds to the Arabic form ميزان (Arabic root و ز ن (w-z-n); مِيزَان (Mīzān)). Its core sense is mizan; balance, scale. Mizan is Arabic مِيزَان (Mīzān) 'balance, scale, justice', from the root و ز ن (w-z-n). The source gloss 'Justice, Balance' is consistent. Recorded at medium confidence because the word is primarily a common noun. Same name as meezan.
